title: DIMENSION group-2 block-name retained owner
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the DXF DIMENSION group-2 anonymous-block name to its parsed owner lease
Preserve replacement, copy/assignment, and reset accounting behavior
Keep programmatic mutation and output-side copies outside this narrowly scoped parsed-field contract

implementation.summary: DRW_Dimension::parseCode now passes DXF group 2 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField using a dedicated byte counter. The explicit copy constructor preserves the counter and resetDwgState clears it. Added a focused selector that uses a generated OLD-to-*D1234 record stream, finds the minimum accepted aggregate cap by binary search, verifies exact-cap success and one-byte-under refusal with the old value intact, and checks copied-lease lifetime through final reset.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_Dimension layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

commands: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md

assessment.claim: The selected DXF parser-owned DIMENSION group-2 string is admitted to the shared logical retained-byte budget, and its charge follows copies until the final reset/destruction. This does not bound allocated capacity, process RSS, programmatic setter mutation, writer-side copies, or typed projection scratch.
assessment.coverage: The generated ASCII parser stream checks replacement at the minimum aggregate budget, one-byte-under failure preserving OLD and its charge, copy construction and assignment, sibling reset, and final release. The owning hardening CTest passes.
assessment.limitations: No full OBJECTS-to-callback stream control, persistent or external drawing, peer parser, native CAD application, full suite, allocation benchmark, or DWG byte-layout change was used.
